revisionReason: Owner decision on 2026-10-12: hold the soak's 30 read-only cycles to the slots the rounds do not change, and hold each slot a round moves to converging on all nine changes with at least one read-only cycle after every change. Every soak measured under revisions 45 to 47 failed only that count, and only on the moved slots, which nine Apply rounds leave short of 30 by construction. Runs measured before keep their verdicts; their reports are judged again by hack/capacity -reevaluate-cycles. The workload, thresholds and every other input are unchanged.
